head: Rule
What it means for ad copy
Where it came from
Applies to
rows: No timing claims on the pension search

Never say the search or transfer takes a minute, is instant, quick, or takes seconds. Approved wording is 'One search, one app, easy'. Describing the app is fine; describing how long the full process takes is not.
Becki, 04/09: 'One search about a minute is misleading, it does not make it sufficiently clear that the full process will take longer.'
B2C-03, B2C-04, and any future find-and-combine copy
No projections, returns or growth figures

Do not state or imply a pot value at retirement, a rate of return, or what someone could have if they start earlier. Any illustration needs the growth assumption disclosed on the asset, which does not fit the format.
Becki, 04/09 (h): 'There is no rate of return provided on the 22 vs 40 projection... we cannot approve this given how little information it provides customers.'
All B2C. 22 vs 40 was withdrawn on this basis
Do not presume personal circumstances or guarantee outcomes
No 'you could have', 'you will be', 'just £20 a week and you are sorted'. Soften to what the product does, not what the customer's life looks like.
Becki, 04/09 (i): 'We cannot presume to know anyone's personal circumstances and we do not want to guarantee, the language needs to be softened.'
All B2C. 20 A Week was withdrawn on this basis

Never write 'free forever', 'always free', 'free for life' or 'guaranteed'. 'Free at any client count' and 'free for your practice' are approved. The word 'forever' was removed from the Partner Pitch creative on 10/09/2026.
RiskSave, 10/09: 'Free at any client count, forever is an unconditional, open-ended commercial promise. Under COBS 4.2.1R this needs to be a claim Compound can actually stand behind.'

Do not say Compound was first, only, or the one that fixed it, and do not reference competitors even implicitly. The Open Apology creatives are approved as written; the copy must not extend the claim any further.
Becki, 04/09 (f): 'This reads as if Compound were the first to provide a find and combine service.' Approved on 09/09 after Dan's push-back.
Compound interest must read as an investment term

If the copy defines compound or compound interest, it must make clear that money is invested and that returns can fall as well as rise. A playful tone is fine; a definition that hides the investment element is not.
Becki, 04/09 (c): 'the current definition really does not make it clear that it is an investment term.' RiskSave suggested: 'the effect where investment returns generate further returns over time'.
B2C-05, B2C-06. Trademark – Dictionary is still not approved on this point
Compound may be described as a registered trade mark in UK finance and as registered with the UK IPO. The Einstein line must stay hedged as 'allegedly'.
RiskSave verified UK00004342650, word mark COMPOUND, Compound Digital Ltd (Co. No. 14077672), Classes 9, 36 and 42, effective 19/02/2026, on the register 31/07/2026.
Illustrative figures must be labelled as illustrations

3,000 contractors, 40 payrolls, 12 providers and the 42 schemes dashboard are all mock-ups. Copy must not present them as Compound's real client data, and the illustration wording in the primary text must not be edited out.
Dan, 04/09: 'it isn't a client we have onboarded (yet) - just an illustration.' Accepted by RiskSave.
Sourced statistics must keep their attribution
The £31.1bn, 3.3 million pots and £9,470 average figures may only be used with the Pensions Policy Institute 2024 attribution attached.
Auto enrolment figures are verified for 2026/27 only
£10,000 earnings trigger and the £6,240 to £50,270 qualifying earnings band are correct for 2026/27. If DWP changes them, both the creative and this copy need re-approval.
RiskSave verified against the DWP December 2025 thresholds review.
Advice disclaimer where the audience is advisers or pricing
'Compound does not provide financial advice' must appear wherever it appears on the creative, and on anything aimed at IFAs.
Risk warning already carried on the Whole Price List and Adviser Scheme creatives.

Confirm with RiskSave whether that is acceptable or whether the copy needs shortening so the warning is visible unexpanded.
